text_summary.body: The people made Jehoahaz king; he reigned three months until the king of Egypt removed him, fined the land 100 talents of silver and one of gold, made Eliakim king under the name Jehoiakim and took Jehoahaz to Egypt.

setting.body: The Babylonian Chronicle (ABC 3) records an Egyptian army crossing the Euphrates to besiege Harran in Du'ûzu–Ulûlu 609, the campaign during which Josiah was killed (2 Kgs 23:29). Kings adds that Necho held Jehoahaz at Riblah.

constraints.subject: evt_01M4V7P26B9BVT8EXZC9VWTJ2T
constraints.textual_assertion: The king of Egypt made Eliakim … king over Judah
assumptions: The installation marks the start of Jehoiakim's reign (window Aug 609 – Jan 608, from ABC 3 and the three months of Jehoahaz).

commentary.paraphrase: Guzik notes that Jehoahaz was the people's, not God's, choice and that Necho imposed tribute and took him to Egypt.

not_applicable.competing_reconstructions: Kings and Chronicles agree on the sequence; no competing reconstruction found.
